subject: Post-demo: Steering onboarding, stakeholder roster, and procurement path
messages:
From: Elena Castillo <ecastillo@northridge.health>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bauer <tbauer@northridge.health>, procurement@northridge.health
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo today — next steps

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Tom and I walked through the platform and liked the latency/cost examples you showed — good fit for our outpatient triage flow. A few things we want to align on before we assemble a steering panel:

- Who is the economic buyer (we think Tom would be, but want confirmation)
- Procurement and legal intake process and typical gating items (examples: security attestations, data residency, indemnity language)
- A compact decision criteria list so our execs can evaluate (SLA, cost run-rate, on-prem option, vendor responsiveness)

We'd like to schedule a 60-minute steering onboarding next week (goal: confirm scope, roles, timeline, and procurement path). Tom is generally available Tue/Wed mornings PST. Can you send a proposed agenda and a short roster of internal stakeholders we should invite?

Also, can you share a short security summary and a draft SOW we can push through procurement?

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Digital Transformation
Northridge Health Systems

--
Attachment: none (will accept your docs via Drive)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Castillo <ecastillo@northridge.health>, Tom Bauer <tbauer@northridge.health>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@northridge.health
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed steering onboarding agenda

Elena / Tom — thanks for the time yesterday. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

Recap:
- Scope discussed: outpatient triage automation (short-term) + analytics for quality (phase 2)
- Key success metrics: 50% reduction in triage turnaround time, sub-200ms p95 generation latency for common prompts, and <10% model-driven false-positive escalation rate

We proposed the following for the 60-minute steering onboarding:
1) 10 min — Introductions and roles (what each stakeholder owns)
2) 15 min — High-level platform demo focused on latency/cost and private deployment options
3) 15 min — Security/compliance checklist and evidence we can produce (SOC2, penetration test summary, data flow diagrams)
4) 10 min — Procurement path & contract template walk-through (high-level redlines we expect)
5) 10 min — Decision criteria and next milestones / timeline

Attachments I've uploaded: Redwood-Steering-Agenda-v1.pdf, Redwood-Security-Summary.pdf, and a draft SOW (Redwood-SOW-draft.docx). I've also dropped a narrow MAP worksheet to help you map stakeholders: Northridge-MAP-worksheet.xlsx

We suggest internal Redwood attendees: Marcus Lin (Account Exec), Neha Kapoor (Security Lead), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineer), and me (Engage lead). Please let me know if you want a deeper infra/ops presence.

Proposed slots (PST): Tue 21 Jul 09:30–10:30, Wed 22 Jul 10:00–11:00, Thu 23 Jul 08:30–09:30. If none work we can adapt.

Action items:
- Elena/Tom: confirm economics owner and which procurement/legal contacts to invite
- Redwood: prepare one-page decision criteria template and extract of SOC2 artifacts that can be shared under NDA

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Solutions Partner, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Redwood-Steering-Agenda-v1.pdf; Redwood-Security-Summary.pdf; Redwood-SOW-draft.docx; Northridge-MAP-worksheet.xlsx
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Csteering-agenda, https://hubspot.com/deals/12345

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed steering onboarding agenda

Looping in a couple quick notes for prep before the steering call:

- We should aim to deliver a redacted SOC2 report + pen test executive summary during the onboarding. Legal/Procurement often ask for a PDF digest rather than full evidence.
- Confirm whether PHI will be in scope for any pilot. If yes, bring our Privacy-Mapping doc and a KMS/HSM options brief.
- I will prepare a 6-slide security summary tailored to healthcare: data flow, encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, and our incident response SLA.

Marcus / Rishi: can you prepare a one-page cost run-rate example (hosted vs private with reserved capacity) that matches the triage volumes Elena mentioned (approx 10M tokens/month)? I'll overlay the security delta if on-prem or VPC is required.

-Neha
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Quoted for context in later replies

From: Tom Bauer <tbauer@northridge.health>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Elena Castillo <ecastillo@northridge.health>
Cc: procurement@northridge.health, legal@northridge.health
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed steering onboarding agenda

Laura / Elena —

Thanks — this looks good. Confirming: I am the economic owner for this initiative and will chair the steering onboarding. Please invite Procurement (procurement@northridge.health) and Legal (legal@northridge.health). From our side the core steering roster should include:

- Tom Bauer (CIO / economic owner)
- Elena Castillo (Director, Digital Transformation / project sponsor)
- Marcus Reed (Clinical Ops lead) <mreed@northridge.health>
- Priya Sharma (Head of InfoSec) <psharma@northridge.health>
- Procurement (contract manager) <procurement@northridge.health>

Availability: Tue 27 Jul 09:00–10:00 PST or Wed 28 Jul 10:00–11:00 PST. Would prefer Tue 27 if possible.

Agenda ask: please include a slide that maps decision criteria to outcomes (e.g., SLA -> uptime targets, Cost -> projected monthly spend, Data controls -> deployment options). Also, can you indicate typical procurement lead time (we've seen 6–10 weeks on similar pilots)?

If you can share the SOC2 digest under an NDA we can jump procurement questions faster. I can route your NDA to our legal contact once we have the base docs.

Tom
CIO, Northridge Health Systems

--
Attachment: none

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Bauer <tbauer@northridge.health>, Elena Castillo <ecastillo@northridge.health>, procurement@northridge.health, legal@northridge.health
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, marcus_reed <mreed@northridge.health>, psharma <psharma@northridge.health>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Steering onboarding Tue 27 Jul 09:00–10:00 PST + prep notes

Tom / Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming Tue 27 Jul 09:00–10:00 PST for the steering onboarding. Calendar invites will go out in a minute and include the agenda and the short decision-criteria template.

Prep notes and ask list:
- We'll circulate a 1-page decision-criteria template (attached) and a 6-slide security brief (Neha) prior to the call.
- Marcus Lin will bring cost run-rate examples (hosted vs dedicated) for the 10M tokens/month case.
- Action for Northridge: please confirm final roster and add any legal/procurement contact emails so we can send the NDA and SOC2 digest.
- We will share the SOC2 digest under NDA only; Laura will send a DocuSign NDA link and a read-only Drive folder with the digest.

Agenda (attached: Redwood-Steering-Agenda-v1.pdf): Intro / roles (10m) | Platform & deployment options (15m) | Security summary (15m) | Procurement path & SOW draft (10m) | Decision criteria & timeline (10m)

Links to docs and NDA: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-Redwood-SOW (for SOW signatures) and https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Csteering-agenda (read-only folder with security digest once NDA complete).

I'll send the NDA to procurement@northridge.health after you confirm the procurement contact who will sign.

Looking forward — we'll keep this tight and focused so execs can decide quickly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Solutions Partner, Redwood Inference

--
